Yuanwu Keqin owns the retained deployment: opening the hall when the yellow rescript renames the temple, declares to the assembly that sky-wrapping earth all sustains itself on grace and the four seas hold its sway, that among the hundred-hundred dharma-gates this is the special gate and among the measureless subtle meanings the true superior meaning, now come down from heaven, residing neither in the eyes' stillness nor the lips' parting, but proved at this moment before the eyes for one taking-up.

Occurrences.Kwic: 前後際斷，生滅心死，三祇劫空。然後於一念中，以一剎那為阿僧祇劫而不長，以阿僧祇劫為一剎那而不促，從朝至暮，念念無虗弃底工夫。儻不如此，何暇閑情妄為雜事？十二時中，四威儀內，貪瞋愛慢，諂曲嫉妬，墮在三界二十五有中，被八萬四千塵勞煩惱籠󰋪，無有出期，固是雜事。然學佛法，求玄妙，事泯默，廣見聞，以至百千法門，無量妙義，一一透徹，及盡精微，尤為雜事。豈知我此宗中無剩底法，但能一念頓證三界二十五有，八萬四千塵勞當下平沈，貪瞋愛慢、諂曲嫉妬復是何物？百千法門、無量妙義，直下如紅爐上一點雪相似，覓其蹤跡了不可得。學佛法、求玄妙、事泯默、廣見聞是什麼人？當恁麼時，閑情尚無，安有雜事？儻不如此，何以隆釋種、紹門風？且道是什麼門風
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X70/X70n1376.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chijue Daochong. Chijue Daochong owns the retained deployment: teaches that even studying the way, seeking the subtle, keeping to silence, and widening one's seeing, down to threading the hundred-hundred dharma-gates and the measureless subtle meanings one by one through to their finest grain, is still miscellaneous business, for this school holds no leftover dharma, and at one thought's sudden attestation the eight-myriad dusts sink on the spot, the gates and meanings going straightway like one fleck of snow on the red furnace, their trace not to be found.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J34/J34nB299.xml). Recorded Sayings of Monk Sanfeng Zang. Hanyue Fazang owns the retained deployment: teaches the students of the living word that Shuilao's saying must be doubled, for having known the root on the hair-tip one must again come to know the hundred-hundred dharma-gates and the measureless subtle meanings, and that of these in world and beyond there are roughly three kinds of speech, the hearer's kind, the buddha-and-bodhisattva kind, and the common person's kind, hemp three ciphers and east mountain walking on water, the dog with no buddha-nature and nothing vast and nothing holy, word-bodies different while the working is never two, so one sentence held to the sky settles the eight-myriad.

Baichi Xingyuan owns the retained deployment: sought to the hall by the elders of Nine Peaks with the gentry, tells them the hundred-hundred dharma-gates and measureless subtle meanings cram the empty sky, filling eye and ear, so that just where eye and ear are full one should hunt a road out, and with one cracking shout and sudden opening may deploy workings, granting and seizing freely, holding up the school's net-cords and crushing demons and outsiders, till song-towers and dance-pavilions are the pure lecture hall.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J37/J37nB389.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuzhaoyunfen of Hongshan. Xiaotang Yunfen owns the retained deployment: at the completion of the Vairocana hall sought by the patron and his son, sets the formula that the hundred-hundred dharma-gates enter only from one gate and the measureless subtle meanings are proclaimed only in one meaning, then lays the staff across asking whether this is not the one gate, stamps once asking whether this is not the one meaning, the one gate entered and the hundred gates burst open at once, the one meaning able to proclaim and the measureless meanings thereupon unfold, till the ten-thousand peaks look up and the streams all run.

Senses.Explanation: The counted plural of the hall, the meanings masters pile up only to land on the tip of one hair or melt into one meaning. Shuilao Heshang, asking Mazu Daoyi for the meaning of the coming from the west and bidden forward, is felled by the chest-block tread, rises with the great laugh that the measureless subtle meanings and the hundred-hundred samadhis are all known at their root on the tip of one hair, Yuanwu Keqin, opening the hall when the yellow rescript renames the temple, declares sky-wrapping earth under grace and the four seas under its sway, among the hundred-hundred dharma-gates the special gate and among the measureless subtle meanings the true superior meaning, now come down from heaven, not in the eyes' stillness or the lips' parting but proved at this moment before the eyes, Chijue Daochong rules that even studying the way, seeking the subtle, sitting silent, and widening one's seeing, down to threading the hundred-hundred gates and the measureless subtle meanings one by one to their finest grain, is still miscellaneous business, since this school holds no leftover dharma and at one thought's awakening they go straightway like one fleck of snow on the red furnace, no trace to be found, and Dahui Zonggao raises Wuzu's three turns, the bare chest and bare feet, the great amnesty that none release, Xie the third son on the fishing boat, ruling that each turn carries the three mysteries and three essentials, the four selections and four host-guests, Dongshan's five ranks and Yunmen's three sentences, the hundred-hundred dharma-gates and measureless subtle meanings, and whoever sorts them out is granted a single eye. Hanyue Fazang teaches the students of the living word that Shuilao's saying must be doubled, for having known the root on the hair-tip one must again know the hundred-hundred gates and measureless subtle meanings, and that in world and beyond there are roughly three kinds of speech, the hearer's, the buddha-and-bodhisattva's, and the common person's, hemp three ciphers and east mountain walking on water, the dog with no buddha-nature and nothing vast and nothing holy, word-bodies different but workings never two, Miyun Yuanwu tells of the monk Jingxi who under his staff found the root and called that staff the great comprehensive holder, just as Shuilao, felled by Mazu's tread and rising with the laugh, knew the hundred-hundred gates and measureless subtle meanings at the tip of a single hair, Baichi Xingyuan, sought to the hall by the elders of Nine Peaks, tells them the hundred-hundred dharma-gates and measureless subtle meanings cram the empty sky, filling eye and ear, so that at the very place where eye and ear are full one should hunt a road out, and with one cracking shout and sudden opening may work freely, holding up the school's net-cords and crushing what stands outside, and Xiaotang Yunfen, at the completion of the Vairocana hall, sets the formula that the hundred-hundred gates enter only through one gate and the measureless meanings are proclaimed only in one meaning, then lays the staff across asking whether this is not the one gate, stamps once asking whether this is not the one meaning, the one gate entered and the hundred gates burst open, the one meaning able to proclaim and the measureless meanings unfold.
